overview.description: Arkham Horror The Card Game is a cooperative commercial living card game where investigators use custom decks to resolve narrative horror scenarios.
overview.deck: Commercial living card game investigator decks and scenario decks

history.origins: Arkham Horror The Card Game was released by Fantasy Flight Games as a cooperative Lovecraftian living card game with campaign progression.
timeline: 2016: Arkham Horror The Card Game is released.
Modern era: Campaign expansions continue the scenario-driven card system.

setup.players: One to four investigators each use a deck and character setup.
setup.deck: Use investigator decks, encounter decks, agenda cards, act cards, locations, and tokens from the commercial set.
setup.equipment: Commercial living card game investigator decks and scenario decks, score area, and enough table space for play.
setup.dealing: Prepare the scenario, shuffle encounter and player decks, draw opening hands, and place starting locations.

rules.objective: Complete the scenario act goals before doom, horror, damage, or encounter effects overwhelm the investigators.
rules.gameplay: Investigators take actions to move, investigate, fight, evade, and play cards. The encounter deck advances threats and narrative pressure. Campaign choices and deck upgrades carry between scenarios.
keyRules: Each investigator has a custom deck.

engine.deckDescription: Deck used for Arkham Horror The Card Game: Commercial living card game investigator decks and scenario decks. Use the ranks, suits, special cards, and pack size described in the setup section for this catalog record.
engine.suitDescription: Four traditional French suits: Hearts (Cœur), Diamonds (Carreau), Clubs (Trèfle), and Spades (Pique), each represented with standard French card iconography and distinct color coding for easy identification.
engine.rankDescription: Standard thirteen ranks per suit: Ace, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, Jack, Queen, and King, where each rank has distinct value and meaning depending on the specific game rules and player strategies.
